s: October 21, 2025 - In 2022, the American Medical Association (AMA) generated about $493 million in revenue. Of that sum, less than $34 million came from membership dues. Other significant revenue sources included insurance commissions ($33.2 million), journal revenues ($30.8 million), and advertising ($13.3 million).
